newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three children die in fire at German asylum centre.
newsitem.headline: Three children die in fire at German asylum centre.

text.p: Three young children from an ethnic Albanian family from southern Serbia died on Friday in a fire that destroyed an asylum seekers' hostel in the western German town of Monheim.
Police said they had found the children's bodies as they combed through the burned-out shell of the block in which around 40 people lived, most of them from former Yugoslavia.
The children, aged three years, two years and three months, were from the Kosovo region of Serbia.
Police said they had not yet established the cause of the fire, which started in the mid-morning, but there was no indication that it might have been started deliberately.
In the past, refugee centres in Germany have been fire-bombed by far-right extremists. Most of these racist attacks occurred in the early morning after midnight.
